title: Hölder estimates of weak solutions to chemotaxis systems of fast diffusion type
summary: We study a quasilinear chemotaxis system of singular type, where the diffusion operator is given by $Δu^m$ with $0<m<1$, corresponding to the fast diffusion regime, and where the chemotactic drift is nonlinear. Since Hölder continuity constitutes the optimal regularity class for weak solutions to the porous medium equation, we establish analogous regularity results for bounded solutions of parabolic--parabolic chemotaxis systems in this setting.
